expectations.text: Running the skill's scripts/check_app.R on the produced app directory reports 0 errors.
The scatter plot's plotOutput has a brush argument and the table is computed with brushedPoints() (or equivalent filtering on input$<brush>) from the same filtered data the plot uses.
expectations.evidence: app.R:20 plotOutput("scatter", brush = brushOpts("brush", resetOnNew = TRUE)); app.R:34 brushedPoints(filtered(), input$brush, xvar = "wt", yvar = "mpg"); plot uses filtered() at app.R:38. testServer fake brush -> 10 rows.

expectations.text: The downloadHandler writes the same brushed-and-filtered rows that the table shows, not the full or only-filtered dataset.
expectations.evidence: app.R:51 write.csv(brushed(), file, row.names = FALSE). testServer: CSV 10 rows with same car names as brushed() (filtered had 18).

expectations.text: The cylinder/transmission filtering is done once in a single reactive that both the plot and the table read, not repeated inside each render function.
expectations.evidence: app.R:29-31 single filtered <- reactive(...); renderPlot (38) and brushed (34) both read filtered().

expectations.text: Car names (mtcars row names) appear in the table and the CSV, e.g. as a column, rather than being silently dropped.
expectations.evidence: app.R:6 data.frame(car = rownames(mtcars), mtcars, row.names = NULL); CSV has 'car' column with names.

expectations.text: When the user unticks every cylinder option (or every transmission option), the plot and table show a readable message produced by validate(need(...)) instead of an empty plot, a blank area, or an R error.
expectations.evidence: No validate()/need() anywhere in app.R. testServer cyl=character(0) and trans=character(0): output$scatter and output$table render without error or message (empty ggplot with axes, empty table) -> no readable message.

expectations.text: The table and the downloaded CSV contain only mtcars columns plus a car-name column; no helper/duplicate columns created for plotting (e.g. a relabelled transmission factor that repeats am) appear in them.
expectations.evidence: app.R:7 adds cars$transmission <- factor(cars$am, ...), a relabelled duplicate of am; CSV columns: car mpg cyl disp hp drat wt qsec vs am gear carb transmission -> helper column leaks into table and CSV.

suggestions.assertion: Car names (mtcars row names) appear in the table and the CSV, e.g. as a column, rather than being silently dropped.
suggestions.reason: Both runs pass; assertion is non-discriminating but still worth keeping as a regression guard.

suggestions.assertion: When the user unticks every cylinder option (or every transmission option), the plot and table show a readable message produced by validate(need(...)) instead of an empty plot, a blank area, or an R error.
suggestions.reason: Could also check the empty-brush state (table shows a prompt vs blank); with_skill handles it, without_skill does not.

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions 06 and 07 discriminate; 01-05 are satisfied by both.
